objective.subject: docs: withdraw installGlobal PIT equivalence claim
objective.body:
The record called the survivor in ParRuntime.installGlobal (removed
closed-runtime checkState) equivalent, following entry E15 of the
2026-10-31 dispositions. Independent review refuted that with two
installers: under the mutant, installing an already-closed runtime
claims the empty slot before its re-check clears it, so a live runtime
installed in that window fails with "already installed" and no runtime
remains installed. The unmutated code rejects the closed runtime before
the claim, as the Javadoc promises.

Record the survivor as a fourth pre-existing ParRuntime gap with its
contract, evidence, impact and next action. It needs the same
maintainer disposition as the other three. Counts and other
dispositions are unchanged.
